name: AI-READY Standard 1.0 (November 2026)
pending: Name and wording to be confirmed by Harsha or Vijay.
changes: When the main thing a practice asks for is shown in full, evidence that shows the rest in part now counts for half of the practice, not a quarter.
Where two readings of the same evidence disagree, a third reading is taken and the three are averaged.
The credit held until the follow-up answers show depth now grows steadily with the credit, so more evidence never counts for less.
A practice first shown in the follow-up stage counts in full.
